comment: Shared expectation table for the package price allocator. Read by BOTH pos_next/api/test_package_allocation_gate.py (TestAllocatePackageRates) and POS/src/utils/packageAllocation.test.js (shared mirror table), so the Python server allocator and the JS offline mirror cannot drift. Invariant per row: sum(rate_i * qty_per_package_i * package_qty) == package_price * package_qty — EXCEPT rows with "exact_sum": false, which pin the fail-closed shape instead (rates still asserted, all >= 0, sum deliberately misses so the server sum check rejects the invoice). The remainder is carried by the last qty-1 child whose weight is above 0; a zero-weight qty-1 child must never carry it (its share is 0, so the leftover would book negative). With no eligible child the last child carries it and the sum can only be exact when the remainder divides its quantity, so a row here without an eligible carrier must either divide evenly or carry "exact_sum": false.
